title: The Quench Pool
text: A thousand years of the forge's blades were quenched in this pool. The water is black, thick as oil and still faintly warm, and it hardens whatever is dipped in it. A smith's hand lies at the bottom, hard as iron.

options.label: Dip your weapons and armor in the black water, trusting a thousand years of smithing.

outcomes.text: Everything comes out harder and sharper, faintly warm for days.
Everything comes out brittle. It cracks at the first strain.

options.label: The toughest drinks the quench water, hoping to harden more than steel.

outcomes.text: Iron enters their blood, and their bones after.
The iron sits in their gut, and it does not want to stay there.

options.label: Bottle some for the House smiths; they will know its worth.

outcomes.text: The smiths will know what to do with it. They will not ask about the hand.
